summary: Order placement is failing because the upstream broker is returning 503s through broker-gateway, which order-router and orchestrator call. The 503 errors start at 13:58:03Z, slightly before the reported 14:00 onset. Over the window, broker-gateway err_rate peaked at 0.307 and order-router err_rate at 0.49. Order-router errors are most likely a consequence of the broker-gateway failure. The only changes in the window were two portfolio-consumer deploys, which are not in the order path. The metrics alone do not show broker-gateway as overloaded: rate_limit_remaining stayed high and rps was modest. I did not retrieve time-series points, so onset and recovery timing are from logs only.

hypotheses.statement: The upstream broker is unavailable and returns 503s to broker-gateway, which fails orders in order-router and orchestrator. The broker-side cause is not visible from our telemetry.
hypotheses.label: medium
